description: Per-stratum table E_0^p ↔ J^p(A) ↔ J^p𝓢 ↔ Π^(p) for p ∈ {0,1,2,3}.  Asserts (a) the categorical, geometric and GB ranks all equal p + 1, and (b) the PL period magnitude is finite and recorded in picard-lefschetz-thimble.witness.json. The horizontal arrow τ : J^p(A) → J^p𝓢 is the only archimedean step in the diagram.
caveats: The proposition is a STRUCTURAL correspondence, not a numerical-equality claim.  This witness records the per-stratum rank table and the existence/finiteness of the PL period; precise period-by-period magnitude equivalences belong to sw-period-thimble-equivalence.witness.json (which carries the A2.4 caveat for k = 1).
